title: Migrate board and stack export records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the board and stack leaf export records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `Permanent`, `CombatCreature`, `StackTarget`, and `StackItem`.

Scope this PR to those four leaf records and the immediate construction/consumption sites in rendering, export loading, and analysis code. Do not pull `Snapshot`, `Decision`, or the root export containers into the same PR.

The goal is to establish the dataclass representation for nested battlefield and stack objects without mixing in higher-level container churn.
